value.rationale: Mutual-visibility sets are a natural graph-geodesic invariant, and the all-cardinality polynomial refines a previously known maximum for an important canonical chain graph. The boundary-index decomposition enables exact counting, size distributions, and nontrivial total counts; it is not a rephrasing of the maximum or a substitution into the complete-bipartite result.
